description: Re-check one app right away (calls its URL), for example to verify a fix after deploying. The result is stored like a scheduled check, so it can open or close an outage. No write access needed; at most once every 30 seconds per app.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

name: run_health_check
title: Run a check now
